title: MIT launches MIT for America to support STEM and AI education
excerpt: President Sally Kornbluth announced the new strategic initiative on October 6, 2026.
bodyHtml:
MIT announced the launch of a new strategic initiative named MIT for America on October 6, 2026, to strengthen STEM education nationally across multiple levels of learning. President Sally Kornbluth made the announcement in a letter to the Institute community.

The initiative includes programs addressing living, learning, and working with artificial intelligence, such as teacher education that helps instructors integrate artificial intelligence into classroom learning. Faculty co-director Cynthia Breazeal and faculty co-director Eric Klopfer lead the initiative alongside other Institute leaders.

The initiative leverages existing efforts such as the MIT RAISE program, which stands for Responsible AI for Social Empowerment and Education, to provide materials and training for teachers. The Institute also launched a related program called Pathways for AI Training and Hiring on October 1.
topic: MIT announces the MIT for America initiative, to strengthen STEM education across the country
